BackstoryDef.title: planet jumper
BackstoryDef.description: After being extracted from the Grey Planet from their successful extermination mission. [PAWN_nameDef] was given extra training to enhance [PAWN_possessive] combat skills. \nNow [PAWN_pronoun] has been sent to the Rimworld to help clear out the unchipped population there.

BackstoryDef.title: pacifist medic
BackstoryDef.description: Despite the scientist's best efforts, [PAWN_nameDef] refused to engage in violence, even to defend [PAWN_possessive]self. However, instead of being disposed of, one scientist figured out that [PAWN_pronoun] could serve as a medic in an extermination squad. \nWhile [PAWN_nameDef] hates combat, [PAWN_pronoun] would rather render medical aid than continue being tortured or executed by the scientists.

BackstoryDef.title: uncaring opportunist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was delighted when [PAWN_pronoun] was informed that [PAWN_pronoun] will be deployed as part of an extermination squad. Being part of an extermination squad meant that [PAWN_pronoun] would be treated vastly better should [PAWN_pronoun] succeed. \n[PAWN_nameDef] is unsure why the other experiments would object to an opportunity such as this.

BackstoryDef.title: shrewd follower
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was quick on the uptake when the scientists started acting more weird than normal. Being a fan-favorite amongst the scientists due to [PAWN_possessive] fast learning, [PAWN_nameDef] knew that something went wrong on the Grey Planet, and that [PAWN_pronoun] was going to be deployed. \nWithout the strength to avoid being deployed, [PAWN_nameDef] stay in wait for an opportunity to escape.

BackstoryDef.title: trapper specialist
BackstoryDef.description: Sensing a gift inside [PAWN_nameDef], [PAWN_possessive] assigned scientist trained [PAWN_objective] in the art of fabricating traps. While just a test of intellect at first, once the Company started needing ground troops to clear out unchipped colonies, [PAWN_nameDef] was deployed to put [PAWN_possessive] skills to use.

BackstoryDef.title: designated backpack
BackstoryDef.description: Seemingly incapable of most tasks. The scientists found it fit that [PAWN_nameDef] would be used as a way to increase the carrying capacity of a squad.

BackstoryDef.title: backstabbing charmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s job was simple. [PAWN_pronoun] would reach out with settlements that have come in contact with other sawians and gather information from them. Once [PAWN_pronoun] got all the information [PAWN_pronoun] needed. [PAWN_possessive] squad would eliminate the settlement. Nobody was to know of the existance of the sawians. \nDue to [PAWN_nameDef] importance, [PAWN_pronoun] was modified to be more appealing, though [PAWN_pronoun] gained an ego through this.

BackstoryDef.title: drug testbed
BackstoryDef.description: To test if combat stimulants would improve the survival rate of extermination sawians, the scientists subjected [PAWN_nameDef] to extensive drug testing. \nDespite their initial expectations, [PAWN_nameDef] was extremely receptive to the testing, super eager each time they went to pickup [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: corporate snitch
BackstoryDef.description: To reduce the number of sawians who abandon the extermination mission, [PAWN_nameDef] was instructed to monitor [PAWN_possessive] squadmates for disloyalty and report it to the company. \nAny sawian who were reported about by [PAWN_nameDef] only found out after their head starts beeping.
